frames.meadow: meadow region frame = env_meadow.glb / meadow_greybox_v0_8.glb root local (game/glTF, Y-up). M6=(0.2,6.5,-25.6). In game: world = meadowRootWorld * p
frames.world: game world (WorldFlowComponent node, island at identity) with env_meadow / env_skycity exactly where RegionJourneyAdapter.ts places them (sky city NOT moved). city local = skycityRootWorld^-1 * p

frame: keys with t < seam.t are in frame "meadow"; keys with t >= seam.t are in frame "world" (each key carries its frame)
origin_meaning: pos = transport_balloon root (basket bottom centre). Girl controllerRoot = node basket_floor / stand_point (+0.10 m Y).
yaw_meaning: balloon node rotation = Ry(yawDeg) * Rz(rollDeg) in the key frame; +Z of the balloon is forward. meadow keys: yawDeg in meadow frame (world yaw = yawDeg + 180); world keys: yawDeg already in game world
interpolation: linear between neighbouring keys of the SAME frame only. t in [seam.t-0.1, seam.t): lerp keys[t=seam.t-0.1] -> seam.preKey (meadow). t >= seam.t: world keys. Never interpolate across the seam.

seam.why_here: after meadow-unload (11.2) and before sky-city-enable (11.6): neither existing scene is drawn, screen is 100% cloud

meadowRootWorld.meaning: game placement of env_meadow root (RegionJourneyAdapter.ts: setRotationFromEuler(0,180,0), player_spawn on islandApproach end + meadowOffset)
meadowRootWorld.formula: p_out = Ry(yawDeg) * p_in + translation (Y-up, right-handed; Cocos setRotationFromEuler(0,yawDeg,0))

skycityRootWorld.meaning: game placement of env_skycity root (RegionJourneyAdapter.ts: skycityYawDeg(), rim landing = walk_path_08 + skycityOffset [18,12,0]); unchanged by the balloon
skycityRootWorld.formula: p_out = Ry(yawDeg) * p_in + translation (Y-up, right-handed; Cocos setRotationFromEuler(0,yawDeg,0))

designCityInMeadowFrame.meaning: v2.1 design placement of env_skycity in the meadow frame (balloonSkyOffset): the post-seam path keeps this RELATIVE layout to the city
designCityInMeadowFrame.formula: p_out = Ry(yawDeg) * p_in + translation (Y-up, right-handed; Cocos setRotationFromEuler(0,yawDeg,0))

meadowToWorld_postSeam.meaning: P = skycityRootWorld * designCityInMeadowFrame^-1 : a design (meadow-frame) point -> game world after the seam
meadowToWorld_postSeam.formula: p_out = Ry(yawDeg) * p_in + translation (Y-up, right-handed; Cocos setRotationFromEuler(0,yawDeg,0))

worldJump.meaning: S = P * meadowRootWorld^-1 : what was at world point q just before the seam is at S*q just after it (rigid; apply to every teleported object and to the camera)
worldJump.formula: p_out = Ry(yawDeg) * p_in + translation (Y-up, right-handed; Cocos setRotationFromEuler(0,yawDeg,0))

objects: transport_balloon (+ girl, she is its child via stand_point)
transit camera (position and look target; FOV unchanged)
teleport.how: easiest: keep the transit content under one node transitFrame. Before the seam transitFrame.world = meadowRootWorld (same as env_meadow root); at the seam set transitFrame.world = meadowToWorld_postSeam. Balloon + camera are driven by the keys (meadow keys under meadowRootWorld, world keys directly). Do it in ONE frame (same update).
not_teleported: env_skycity (stays where the game puts it)

continuity.method: camera-relative pose (position in camera space + rotation) of balloon / transit_clouds root / far card root, pre (meadow key under meadowRootWorld) vs post (world key)

lighting.note: the world light does not move with the teleport, so its direction relative to the camera turns by worldJump_yawDeg at the seam. Recommended: from t=10.7 (cloud cover >= 0.99) to the seam, add a yaw of -worldJump_yawDeg (= +104.253 deg) to the Main Light, ramped; at the seam set it back to the game value in the same frame as the teleport. The screen is 100% cloud, so the city/meadow are never lit by the ramped light.

landing.note: S0 = transitions-DESIGN.md S0 table point in env_skycity local coords (no S0 symbol exists in the repo); its in-game position = skycityRootWorld * S0_local

balloonSkyOffset.note: v2.1 DESIGN placement (meadow frame) - used only to build the post-seam path relative to the city; the game does NOT move env_skycity

renderingHints.skyDomes: env_sky_dome (day) and transit_night_dome (night) render as a SKYBOX: drawn first (lowest priority / own queue before opaque), depthWrite=false (depthTest off or LEQUAL with depth cleared after), camera-centred (follow camera position, not rotation). Exactly one dome enabled at a time.
renderingHints.opaqueOrder: balloon, transit clouds, far_meadow_card, env_sea_surface, env_skycity: normal opaque queue, depthWrite on, after the skybox

sceneSwitch.rule: env_meadow rendered only for t < meadowOff_t; env_skycity rendered only for t >= skyCityOn_t; meadowOff_t < seam_t < skyCityOn_t, all inside the full-screen cloud window, so the two scenes are never rendered at the same moment
sceneSwitch.preload: load region_skycity (inactive) during the climb, before meadowOff_t; destroy/unload region_meadow after meadowOff_t

farMeadowCard.object: far_meadow_card (glb/far_meadow_card.glb, 1 opaque material, no alpha, no emission)
farMeadowCard.frame: meadow frame identity (exactly where env_meadow was) until the seam; teleported with the clouds at the seam
farMeadowCard.rule: turn on in the SAME frame as meadow-unload (never together with env_meadow); stays under the cloud plain (>= 4 m to every cloud); seen only through the cloud-plain gaps, always below the horizon
farMeadowCard.version: 2.3 (drop-in replacement of glb/far_meadow_card.glb: same file, node, material names; node transform and frame convention unchanged)
farMeadowCard.nodeTransform: identity in the meadow frame (child of transitFrame like transit_clouds_merged); unchanged from v2.2

geometry.kind: hazed miniature of the meadow island + hazed-sea skirt, baked into the vertices

haze.skirt: inner = hazed sea, outer rings fade to the game-sea albedo

optionalEngineFog.note: NOT needed: haze is baked. If the scene already uses Cocos fog during the transit, keep it LINEAR and far so it does not double-haze the card or grey the clouds

recedeOverTime.note: static is enough: the gaps scroll over the island as the balloon climbs/cruises (card visible 14.2-20.6 s); no per-frame transform needed

visibilityRules.skyCity: env_skycity hidden for t < 11.6 (inside the full-screen cloud), shown after; no geometry cut
visibilityRules.citySeaClouds: cloud groups clouds_city_sea, clouds_floor and clouds_floor_puff follow skyCity visibility (on from skyCityOn_t)
visibilityRules.transitClouds: clouds_deck, clouds_deck_loose, clouds_far, clouds_horizon: on for the whole transit

worldBackdrops.env_sea_surface: game sea (island model, y=-0.9185). Teleport with worldJump at the seam (post-seam world y = -49.047) so its height under the clouds/city matches the design; scale x/z by 6 for the transit (renders). Put it back (identity, scale 1) at the hand-off after the landing.

visibilityRules.dayDome: env_sky_dome for the whole transit = exactly one sky layer, rendered as skybox (renderingHints)
visibilityRules.nightDome: transit_night_dome only, rendered as skybox; env_sky_dome and meadow_sky_dome disabled

night.M_transit_cloud_emissive: set emissiveFactor to [0,0,0] at night (clouds stay opaque, lit by moon/ambient only)

visibilityRules.girl: girl stands on balloon node basket_floor / stand_point; the render stand-in faces the 离地 camera (yaw -76.6 deg relative to the basket)
